arxiv-2409-11207.title: Comparison of Impedance Matching Networks for Scanning Microwave Microscopy
arxiv-2409-11207.creator: Johannes Hoffmann, Sophie de Préville, Bruno Eckmann, Hung-Ju Lin, Benedikt Herzog, Kamel Haddadi, Didier Théron, Georg Gramse, Damien Richert, José Morán-Meza and François Piquemal
arxiv-2409-11207.description: Abstract In this paper, a definition of the gain and added noise of impedance matching networks for scanning microwave microscopy is given. This definition can be used to compare different impedance matching techniques independently of the instrument used to measure the S-parameter.

arxiv-2501-13374.title: A hidden Condorcet domain in Loday’s realisation of the associahedron
arxiv-2501-13374.creator: Arkadii Slinko
arxiv-2501-13374.description: Abstract We prove that Loday’s polytopal realisation of the n n th Tamari lattice, called associahedron, has 2 n − 1 2^{n-1} common points with the permutohedron, which form a maximal never-middle (symmetric) Condorcet domain. 1 Introduction The origin of Condorcet domains is in voting theory.

arxiv-2501-16012.title: Large area monocrystalline and surfactant-free copper microflake synthesis
arxiv-2501-16012.creator: Elif Nur Dayi, Diotime Pellet, Priscila Vensaus, Fatemeh Kiani, Alan R. Bowman, Omer Can Karaman, Giulia Tagliabue
arxiv-2501-16012.description: Abstract Copper is one of the most extensively studied materials for energy conversion and catalytic systems, with a wide range of other applications from nanophotonics to biotechnology. However, existing synthesis methods are limited with many undesirable by-products and poorly defined morphologies.

arxiv-2508-08263.title: Characterizations of Dual of K K -frames in Quaternionic Hilbert Spaces
arxiv-2508-08263.creator: Chander Shekhar
arxiv-2508-08263.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Chander Shekhar. Dual of K − K- frames in a right quaternionic Hilbert space has been recently introduced and studied by Ellouz [ 1 ] . In this paper, we study duals of K − K- frames and prove a characterization of a K − K- dual in terms of the canonical K − K- dual of a K − K- frame in the case when the range of K K is not necessarily closed.

arxiv-2511-16301.title: Upsample Anything: A Simple and Hard to Beat Baseline for Feature Upsampling
arxiv-2511-16301.creator: Minseok Seo, Mark Hamilton, Changick Kim, [0.25em] KAIST
arxiv-2511-16301.description: Abstract We present Upsample Anything , a lightweight test-time optimization (TTO) framework that restores low-resolution features to high-resolution, pixel-wise outputs without any training. Although Vision Foundation Models demonstrate strong generalization across diverse downstream tasks, their representations are typically downsampled by 14×/16× (e.g., ViT), which limits their direct use in pixel-level applications.

britannica-1911-mackay-hugh.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-mackay-hugh.description: Article 'Mackay, Hugh' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 17), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. the son of Hugh Mackay of Scourie, Sutherlandshire, and was born there about 1640. He entered Douglas’s (Dumbarton’s) regiment of the English army (now the Royal Scots) in 1660, accompanied it to France when it was lent by Charles II. to Louis XIV., and though succeeding, through the death of his two elder brothers, to his father’s estates, continued to serve abroad.

pmc-10495457.creator: Huiqi Li, Zhaocong Wang, Lei Wang, Yang Tan, Feng Chen
pmc-10495457.description: Whispering-gallery-mode microcavity lasers possess remarkable characteristics such as high Q factors and compact geometries, making them an essential element in the evolution of microlasers. pmc-11932157.creator: Amanda N Szabo-Reed, Amber Watts, Eric D Vidoni, Jonathan Mahnken, Angela Van Sciver, Katrina Finley, Jonathan Clutton, Rachel Holden, Mickeal N Key, Jeffery M Burns
pmc-11932157.description: The health care system is insufficiently capitalizing on the benefits of physical exercise in America’s aging population. The Lifestyle Empowerment for Alzheimer’s Prevention (LEAP!

pmc-12566595.title: Mechanical Ball Milling-Assisted Synthesis of Esterified Starch for Polybutylene Succinate Blend with Improved Performance
pmc-12566595.creator: Wenjing Cai, Canqi Huo, Jisuan Tan, Zirun Chen, Yanzhen Yin, Yong Jin, Dimitrios Bikiaris
pmc-12566595.description: Polybutylene succinate (PBS), as one of the most promising multi-application polymer, still suffers from low toughness, poor miscibility, and high crystallinity. Blending with starch is an effective strategy to improve the properties of PBS, but the compatibility and dispersity between starch and PBS still need to be optimized.

pmc-12670513.title: Harnessing Photochemistry in Natural Product Synthesis: From Strategy to Applications
pmc-12670513.creator: Elina K. Taskinen, Burkhard König
pmc-12670513.description: Photochemistry and total synthesis are deeply rooted in the history of organic chemistry, each developing independently while also intersecting frequently. Indeed, mild reaction conditions, versatility of transformations, and complementary selectivities to thermal methods make photochemistry an especially powerful tool for the synthesis of complex target molecules.

pmc-12733582.title: Five New Species of Gibellula (Hypocreales, Cordycipitaceae) from China
pmc-12733582.creator: Bo Tu, Hui Chen, Xu Zhang, Yu-Hu Guan, De-Xiang Tang, Qi-Rui Li, Yao Wang, Seung-Yoon Oh
pmc-12733582.description: The genus Gibellula (Cordycipitaceae, Hypocreales) comprises highly specialized, obligate pathogens that exclusively parasitize spiders. In this study, five new species were delimited based on morphological and phylogenetic evidence from a six-locus dataset (nrSSU, ITS, nrLSU, tef-1α, rpb1, rpb2). Specimens were collected from northeastern (Jilin and Liaoning Provinces) and southwestern (Yunnan Province) China.

pmc-12812869.title: Enhancing learning outcomes through post-discussion homework: the role of collaboration and task type
pmc-12812869.creator: Xuejiao Cheng, Ruizhu Yuan, Qihao Zhang, Chengxi Zhai
pmc-12812869.description: This study investigates how post-discussion homework can be designed to sustain the inclusive, collaborative dynamics of seminar teaching. Through a 2 × 2 quasi-experimental design with 36 graduate students, we examined how social architecture (collaborative vs. individual homework) and task type (concept-oriented vs. case-oriented assignments) jointly relate to learning outcomes.

pmc-12952996.title: Prevalence of Therapeutic Inertia in the Management of Overweight and Obesity in Patients With a Diagnosis of Type 2 Diabetes Who Are Followed up by Primary Care Physicians
pmc-12952996.creator: Pablo Aschner, Diana Henao‐Carrillo
pmc-12952996.description: IntroductionInformation on therapeutic inertia (TI) in weight loss in people with type 2 diabetes (T2D) is limited.ObjectiveTo describe the prevalence of TI in the management of overweight/obesity in people with T2D undergoing primary care program (PCP) follow‐up and weight changes according to the prescribed treatment.

pmc-12962788.title: A Case of Acquired Hemophilia A Following Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Esophagectomy
pmc-12962788.creator: Shota Eguchi, Yoshio Nagahisa, Kenji Yamaguchi, Yukio Inamura, Michio Okabe, Toshihiko Masui
pmc-12962788.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). INTRODUCTIONAcquired hemophilia A (AHA) is a rare but potentially fatal bleeding disorder that arises suddenly in individuals without a prior history of bleeding tendency. It is often associated with malignant disease and can present with severe hemorrhagic complications. Reports of AHA occurring in the postoperative course of esophageal cancer surgery are extremely limited, and the safety of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) in patients with a history of AHA remains uncertain.

pmc-12983679.title: Trajectories of metabolic risk clusters and adverse outcomes in patients with chronic kidney disease: a prospective cohort study in Taiwan
pmc-12983679.creator: Wei-Cheng Lo, Mei-Yi Wu, Yi-Hsuan Roger Chen, Mai Szu Wu, Chung‑Shun Wong
pmc-12983679.description: AbstractObjectivesTo investigate the association between longitudinal trajectories of metabolic risk clusters and the risk of progression to end-stage kidney disease (ESKD) and major adverse kidney events (MAKEs) in patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD).DesignProspective registry-based cohort study.SettingSecondary and tertiary care settings in Taiwan, using data from a multidisciplinary pre-ESKD care programme.

pmc-13185827.title: Single‐Cell Metabolic Imaging and Digital Scoring of Fat Tissue Remodeling by Label‐Free Metabolic Microscopy
pmc-13185827.creator: Myeongseop Kim, Constantin Berger, Alexander Wolf, Alina Peteranderl, Martin Klingenspor, Vasilis Ntziachristos, Yongguo Li, Miguel A. Pleitez
pmc-13185827.description: Adipose tissue plasticity and functional heterogeneity play a central role in maintaining energy homeostasis, and their malfunction leads to metabolic disorders such as obesity, diabetes, and cardiometabolic disease. Rapid, single‐cell metabolic imaging of intact fat tissue not only extends our understanding of metabolic dynamics and heterogeneity but also holds great potential as a tool for clinical diagnosis.

pmc-13358355.title: Quality of Life Among Patients With Epilepsy in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia: A Descriptive Cross‐Sectional Study
pmc-13358355.creator: Ruba Alharazi, Yara Abushosha, Nouf A. Aldajany, Nouf J. Alreziq, Lujain A. Sallam, Aisha Alhofaian, Loujain S. Sharif
pmc-13358355.description: BackgroundEpilepsy is one of the most common neurological conditions which affects 50 million individuals worldwide and has a high prevalence rate in Saudi Arabia (0.654%). Epilepsy negatively impacts the global health and lowers the quality of life (QoL) of affected individuals.

pmc-13401323.title: Study protocol for Full Speed Ahead: an intervention for improved activities in daily life through Frame Running and Goal directed training
pmc-13401323.creator: Ann-Christin Eliasson, Kristina Löwing, Emma Hjalmarsson, Cecilia Lidbeck, Agnes Adestedt, Julia Starck, Magnus Aspdahl, Josefin Löwing, Emelie Frisk, Johanna Strand, Annika Ericson, Kristina Andersson, Eva Broström, Ola Kvist, Jessica Norrbom, Ferdinand von Walden

pmc-13516221.title: Stable In Vitro Cultivation of the Myxozoan Enteromyxum leei for over 12 Months: Integration of a Physical Aggregation Technique for Long-Term Antiparasitic Interventions
pmc-13516221.creator: Eun Ji Jeon, Han Gill Seo, Na Young Kim, Ahran Kim, Myoung Sug Kim, Jeong Wan Do, Hyun Ja Han, Hyun Sil Kang, Soo Ji Woo
pmc-13516221.description: Emaciation disease, primarily caused by the myxosporean parasite Enteromyxum leei, poses a significant economic threat to the olive flounder (Paralichthys olivaceus) aquaculture industry. Research on E. leei has been severely restricted by its status as an unculturable obligate parasite and its extreme sensitivity to cryopreservation.

pmc-13525322.title: Successful Reversal of Tamoxifen-Associated Weight Gain and Metabolic Dysfunction with Liraglutide in a Breast Cancer Survivor: A Case Report
pmc-13525322.creator: Masharibov Anvarbek, Doniyor Umarov, Zarina Khalbayeva, Aseel Smerat, Mohammad Adi, Ahmed Ashraf
pmc-13525322.description: Introduction: Adjuvant endocrine therapy for breast cancer - particularly tamoxifen - is commonly associated with weight gain, increased adiposity, and metabolic dysfunction. Lifestyle measures often fail to reverse these effects. Evidence regarding glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists in this specific context remains limited. Reversal of tamoxifen-associated weight gain with liraglutide has been rarely reported.

pmc-13564620.title: Decoding Sebaceous Gland Biology Through Experimental Models: Progress, Limitations, and Future Directions
pmc-13564620.creator: Stefania Briganti, Sarah Mosca, Monica Ottaviani, Enrica Flori
pmc-13564620.description: The sebaceous gland (SG) is a highly dynamic skin appendage that plays a central role in maintaining skin homeostasis through lipid production, immune modulation, and interactions with the skin microbiome. Dysregulation of SG function is implicated in several dermatological disorders, including acne and other inflammatory skin diseases.

uslaw-usc-t2-s4713.title: 2 U.S.C. § 4713 — Reporting payments made to witnesses before Committee on Standards of Official Conduct
uslaw-usc-t2-s4713.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t2-s4713.description: United States Code, Title 2 (The Congress); Chapter 47 (Congressional Ethics); Subchapter II (House Of Representatives). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Notwithstanding any other provision of law or any other rule or regulation, any information on payments made by the Committee on Standards of Official Conduct of the House of Representatives to an individual for attendance as a witness before the Committee.

uslaw-usc-t28-s115.title: 28 U.S.C. § 115 — Ohio
uslaw-usc-t28-s115.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t28-s115.description: United States Code, Title 28 (Judiciary And Judicial Procedure); Part I (Organization Of Courts); Chapter 5 (District Courts). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Ohio is divided into two judicial districts to be known as the Northern and Southern Districts of Ohio. Northern District (a) The Northern District comprises two divisions. (1) The Eastern Division comprises the counties of Ashland, Ashtabula, Carroll, Columbiana.
